title: Marketing Campaign Executive
description:
Job Title: Campaign Executive

Location: Pudsey, West Yorkshire

Salary: From £28,500 per year

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

Hours: Mon-Fri, 8:45am - 17:45pm

Start Date: ASAP

About Us

LINK Communication creates effective brand experiences through promotional sampling and experiential marketing.

With over 28 years' experience, we deliver campaigns across supermarkets, convenience retailers, consumer events and trade shows for leading food, drink, lifestyle and technology brands. We are proud to have won 'The Most Effective Retail Sales Experience' award for eight consecutive years.

Our experienced team manages every aspect of campaign delivery, from staffing and logistics to branded equipment and full event experiences.

About the Role

Working as part of our Campaign Team, you will manage a varied range of marketing campaigns and events across the UK, from initial planning through to completion.

This role is based at our office in Pudsey. Applicants must live within a commutable distance or be planning to relocate before starting.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Planning
- Review campaign briefs, client requirements, deadlines and budgets.
- Agree timelines, reporting requirements, purchase orders, billing details and practical arrangements with clients.
- Maintain accurate campaign information, including staffing rates, expenses, shift times and invoicing details.
- Create task plans, staffing instructions, location maps, equipment lists and campaign timelines.
- Support the recruitment, selection, vetting and briefing of suitable campaign staff.
- Coordinate venues, equipment, print, suppliers, travel, accommodation, logistics and couriers.
- Manage supplier costs and monitor expected campaign profitability.
- Complete venue documentation, health and safety planning, staff training and final pre-campaign checks.

Live Campaign Management
- Oversee live campaigns to ensure they are delivered safely and in line with the agreed brief.
- Monitor activity through photographs, feedback, results and location tracking.
- Quickly resolve any staffing, equipment, venue, logistical or performance issues.
- Provide clients with timely updates, photographs and daily or weekly reports.
- Gather accurate campaign results and feedback from staff, customers and venues.
- Record staff performance and share relevant feedback with the staffing team.
- Keep internal teams updated on client communications and campaign changes.
- Remain contactable during agreed busy weekend periods to support your live campaigns.

Post-Campaign Management
- Coordinate staff debriefs, equipment returns, campaign close-down and the organisation of reusable assets.
- Produce accurate final reports and confirm that all campaign requirements have been completed.
- Complete financial reconciliations and review campaign profitability.
- Evaluate performance and key learnings to improve future campaign delivery.
- Hold post-campaign discussions with clients and identify further opportunities.

Client and Account Development
- Build and maintain positive, long-term client relationships.
- Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and re-engage lapsed clients.
- Keep client details and campaign records up to date within the company CRM.
- Support LINK's social media activity by sharing content about current and upcoming campaigns.

About You

We are looking for someone who has:
- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to work with clients, colleagues, suppliers and campaign staff.
- Strong organisation skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- A proactive, practical approach to solving problems.

Previous marketing, events or campaign experience would be beneficial but is not essential, as full training will be provided.

The position may be particularly suited to graduates in Marketing, Events, PR or Communications who have gained some relevant work experience.

What You'll Get from Us
- Competitive salary
- Paid leave on your birthday and Christmas Eve
- Early Friday finish
- One work-from-home day per week, where possible
- Training, development and ongoing support
- Friendly office team
- Company events
- Company pension
- Free parking
- Sick pay

Please click APPLY to send us your CV and cover letter.

Candidates with experience as a Campaign Executive, Marketing Executive, Events Executive, Brand Activation Executive, Field Marketing Executive or Account Executive may also be considered.

This job description provides an overview of the main duties and responsibilities and is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve in line with business needs, and the postholder may be required to undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Role: Marketing Executive - Wakefield

Salary: £35k- £40k DOE per annum

WorkingHours: Monday to Friday 9am-5pm

We're working with a leading SaaS business who are looking for a dynamic and results-oriented Marketing Executive to support their business development efforts.

The successful candidate will play a crucial role in increasing brand awareness, generating leads, and solidifying our position in the market. This role requires a blend of creativity, analytical skills, and a proactive approach to identifying growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

Market Research & Analysis:

Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, customer needs, and the competitive landscape. Analyse customer segments and develop targeted marketing strategies.

Marketing Strategy Development:

Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement marketing strategies that align with business development objectives. Assist in defining marketing goals and KPIs.

Tender Identification & Response:

Research and find appropriate tenders that align with the company's offerings and strategic goals. Write and submit high-quality ITT responses, ensuring all submissions meet the requirements outlined in the tender documents.

Content Creation:

Create compelling content for various platforms, including blogs, newsletters, and marketing collateral that promote our services. Manage website content updates, ensuring all information is accurate, engaging, and optimised for SEO. Regularly update LinkedIn and other social media profiles to reflect our current offerings, achievements, and industry-related insights.

Digital Marketing:

Manage and optimise digital marketing campaigns across platforms (SEO/SEM, PPC, email marketing, and social media). Utilise analytical tools to track and report on campaign performance and ROI.

Opportunity Pipeline Reporting:

Develop and maintain reporting on the sales opportunity pipeline, including tracking potential leads and current engagements. Provide insights and recommendations based on pipeline data to optimise marketing and sales strategies.

DMU Engagement:

Utilise LinkedIn to locate and engage with Decision-Making Unit (DMU) contacts within our target sectors. Connect with potential clients and stakeholders through direct messaging to foster relationships and explore business opportunities.

Collaboration & Communication:

Work closely with the sales team to create promotional materials, pitch decks, and presentations that support business development. Engage with industry partners and stakeholders to explore collaboration opportunities.

Event Management:

Support the planning and execution of marketing events, webinars, and trade shows to showcase our products and services. Gather feedback and insights following events to refine future strategies.

Brand Management:

Ensure consistent brand messaging across all marketing channels. Monitor brand perception and make recommendations for improvements

Essential skills & Attributes
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.
- 2-4 years of experience in a marketing role, preferably in the SaaS or technology sector.
- Proven experience in digital marketing, content creation, and lead generation
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with marketing analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, etc.).
- Experience with website content management systems (CMS) and social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
- Experience with marketing automation tools is preferred.

Skills:
- Proven experience in marketing, with a strong understanding of market dynamics.
- Proficiency in digital marketing tools, particularly Google Ads and email marketing platforms.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Leadership capabilities to guide teams towards achieving shared objectives.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present ideas clearly.
- Familiarity with IT systems and office software applications is essential.
- Creative mindset with a keen eye for detail when producing marketing materials.

title: Senior Insight Executive
description:
Location: Hybrid 2 days a week in Bradford Hillmore House
Salary: From £33,000 + 10% discretionary bonus
Level: Executive

Who are we?

My Client SMG We're the original pioneers in connected commerce marketing. Since 2008, we've been partnering with major retailers, powering global brands, and building meaningful connections with shoppers.

We simplify the mind-boggling complexity of today's retail media landscape. We deliver impactful campaigns that connect with people where it matters. We create seamless and personalised shopping experiences. Above all, we deliver amazing results for our partners, driven by our unshakeable desire for growth. Time after time, we change the game. SMG is home to a world-class suite of commerce advertising capabilities powered by data and cutting-edge technology. We constantly push ourselves, our tech and our industry to discover innovative new ways to connect, sell and grow.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Insight Executive to join our Morrisons Media Group (MMG) Team.
- Turn customer and campaign data into actionable insights that shape brand strategy and marketing investment.
- Help leading brands make smarter, data-driven marketing decisions using Morrisons customer insights.
- Become the subject matter expert for MoreViu, Morrisons' customer insight platform, driving its adoption across the business.
- Deliver insight-led recommendations that identify growth opportunities and improve campaign performance.
- Support strategic planning by uncovering customer trends, behaviours, and opportunities.
- Showcase the value of Morrisons Media Group through impactful analysis and compelling client insights.
- Work closely with internal teams and brands to influence planning with customer and campaign data.
- Drive innovation by expanding MMG's insight capabilities and embedding data into decision-making

What you'll do
- Use consumer, sales and campaign data to generate actionable insight that informs media planning, demonstrates campaign effectiveness and identifies future opportunities for brand growth.
- Partner with colleagues across Connected Media and Client Services to provide insight that supports commercial conversations, audience planning and the development of retail media propositions.
- Lead the development and adoption of MMG's MoreViu platform, embedding it within the business and enabling colleagues to make the most of its customer and audience insight capabilities.
- Transform complex data into compelling stories and presentations that communicate clear, evidence-based recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.
- Drive continuous improvement across MMG Insights by refining analytical approaches, sharing best practice and helping evolve the tools, processes and methodologies that support the team's delivery.

What we're looking for:

Essential
- Strong understanding of how retailers, brands or category teams use customer insight to make commercial decisions.
- Strong analytical capability with experience working across multiple customer or retail datasets
- Ability to transform analysis into compelling commercial narratives
- Experience producing presentation decks rather than simply reports
- Excellent presentation and communication skills
- Highly organised with the ability to prioritise multiple requests
- Strong stakeholder management skills
- Naturally curious with a problem-solving mindset
- Advanced Excel skills

Desirable
- Experience using audience planning or customer insight platforms (MoreViu, Kantar, Circana, Dunnhumby, Nectar 360, etc.)
- Understanding of retail media
- Experience with campaign measurement
- Knowledge of customer segmentation and audience planning
- SQL or other data querying experience

We're looking for people who enjoy the buzz of change, the satisfaction of building something better, and the joy of working with a close-knit, values-driven team. If you love variety, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and embrace change with energy, this could be your right role.

Don't meet every single requirement? We still want to hear from you. If you believe you'd thrive in this role, your unique perspective might be just what we're looking for.

Why SMG?

At SMG, we hire for the future, which is fast-moving and changing shape. Do you have the potential to help shape our business? We're looking for brilliant, diverse talent who want to grow with us - people who are curious, ambitious, and eager to learn, whether as specialists or across teams.

We value those who take ownership of their growth and bring fresh perspectives. That's why we're committed to equity, inclusion, and building a place where everyone feels empowered to grow. At SMG, it's not just about filling a role but building the future together.

Position Overview:

Elevation Recruitment are partnering with a fast growing manufacturer and e-commerce retailer.

Unlike many online competitors, they design and manufacture our own products right here in the UK.

Organic social content will play an increasingly important role in driving awareness, increasing engagement, strengthening brand relevance and supporting long-term commercial growth.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, we're looking for a highly creative, culturally connected and commercially driven Social Media and Content Creator to own and scale our organic social presence across a portfolio of leading home and brands.

This role goes far beyond publishing content. You'll operate as an in-house content creator, storyteller and growth driver developing ideas, creating social-first campaigns and building content that increases brand awareness, audience engagement and ultimately contributes to commercial growth.

Working across multiple brands and channels, you'll create content ecosystems rather than isolated posts developing repeatable formats, content series and audience-led storytelling designed to grow reach, community and customer demand.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone obsessed with content, trends and platform behaviour, but equally comfortable using data and performance insight to guide creative decisions.

The focus is on organic content strategy, content production, community growth and performance optimisation aligned to wider brand and business objectives.

Responsibilities:

Organic Social content strategy & Growth

- Build scalable content frameworks balancing:
- Brand storytelling
- Product education
- Trends and culture
- Seasonal activity
- Inspiration-led content
- Community engagement
- Commercial priorities

Content Creation & Creative Production

- Create content that balances creativity, entertainment, inspiration and commercial impact.
- Short-form video
- Static content
- Carousels
- Stories
- Motion content

Campaign Development & Creative Ideation

- Generate fresh, proactive ideas aligned to:
- Platform behaviour
- Audience interests
- Cultural moments
- Emerging trends
- Seasonal opportunities

Videography & Editing

- Maintain a fast-turnaround content workflow.
- Edit video content to a high standard including:
- Captions
- Motion graphics
- Sound
- Transitions
- Platform optimisation
- Create engaging:
- Reels
- TikToks
- Stories
- YouTube Shorts
- Behind-the-scenes content

- 3+ years' experience in social media, content creation or organic social roles
- Proven experience creating high-performing organic content for consumer or e-commerce brands
- Strong understanding of short-form video storytelling and platform-native content
- Demonstrable experience creating content from concept through to execution
- Experience filming and editing social content
- Strong graphic design capability
- Strong copywriting skills for hooks, captions and social messaging
- Experience analysing content performance and translating insight into action
- Strong understanding of platform best practice across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest and YouTube
- Experience balancing creativity with commercial objectives
- Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments
- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

Desirable Requirements:
